summary: This video showcases a high-performing Burn team against Joyce, a Continental Challenge boss in Season 8. The lineup composed of Durem, Karf, Synarell, Paixton, and Naro achieves an S-rank score of 880.6 million damage. Detailed gear sets, stat priorities, and artifact recommendations are provided for each hero. Exact skill rotation timings are demonstrated, featuring synchronized 18-second recasts to optimize debuffs and damage windows.

heroes.note: Built for full damage output while maintaining over 100 Accuracy.

teams.note: Deals 880,618,805 damage (Rank S). Uses an 18-second recast cycle across all heroes with staggered initial casts.

tips: Ensure Durem has over 100 Accuracy alongside full damage stats to land debuffs reliably on Joyce.
Equip Paixton with the Puppeteer set and defensive stats for frontline endurance.
Maximize Accuracy on Naro while running the Carcass artifact.
Synchronize team ultimate recasts to 18.0 seconds with staggered initial casts (Karf at 11.3s, Paixton and Synarell at 22.0s, Durem at 25.6s, Naro at 27.6s).
